---
title: "All MAGs Planktothrix"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-02-07"
---
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
```


Get contigs, contamination, completness, and size from checkm
```{r}
checkm <- read.csv(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/checkm_dastool_all20_combined.csv",
  colClasses = c(culture = "character", genome_base = "character")
)

checkm <- checkm %>%
  mutate(
    old_bin_name = genome_base,

    # Remove the old metaSPAdes wording
    genome_base = str_remove(genome_base, "_metaSPAdes"),

    # Rename numeric CONCOCT bins
    genome_base = if_else(
      str_detect(genome_base, "^\\d+(_sub)?$"),
      paste0(culture, "_concoct.", genome_base),
      genome_base
    )
  )

# Select only the desired columns
checkm <- checkm[, c("genome_base", "number_of_contigs", "contamination", "completeness", "genome_size_bp")]

```


Rename and organize columns
```{r}
final_data <- checkm %>%
  rename(
    `Culture Origin` = `genome_base`,
    `Bin completeness` = `completeness`,
    `Bin contamination` = `contamination`,
    `Number of contigs` = `number_of_contigs`,
    `Size of genome (bp)` = `genome_size_bp`
  )

#order it
final_data <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Culture Origin`, 
    `Bin completeness`, 
    `Bin contamination`, 
    `Number of contigs`, 
    `Size of genome (bp)`
  ) %>%
  arrange( as.numeric(str_extract(`Culture Origin`, "^[0-9]+")), as.numeric(str_extract(`Culture Origin`, "(?<=\\.)[0-9]+")) )

```



export
```{r}
write.csv(final_data, "AllMAGs417.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
